verdict.rationale: Temporal documents one first-party integration, with the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python, that runs agents as Workflows. Model calls in that integration execute as Activities, so they retry durably and survive Worker restarts without custom glue code. Other providers, such as Claude and the OpenAI API library, appear only as cookbook recipes rather than packaged integrations. Missing for 10: first-party integrations beyond the OpenAI Agents SDK (other AI SDKs, agent frameworks and model providers), language coverage beyond Python, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
